facts.business: IKIO Technologies Limited is an innovation-driven Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) providing end-to-end solutions across product lifecycle from concept and design to engineering, manufacturing, and delivery, serving global markets across LED lighting, energy solutions, product display systems, and consumer electronics.

capacity_or_capex.item: Noida Greenfield Facility Block I (2 lakh sq. ft.)
Noida Greenfield Facility Block II (2 lakh sq. ft.)
Noida Greenfield Facility Block III (1 lakh sq. ft.)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Block II expected to be commercialised by Q1 FY27
Once all facilities fully operational, total capacity to reach 8 lakh sq. ft.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No key audit matters communicated; unqualified opinion on standalone financial statements

key_risks: Customer concentration risk (revenue from major customers exceeding 10% in multiple subsidiaries)
Dependence on export markets (53% revenue from outside India)
Execution risk on greenfield expansion (Block II and Block III)
facts.related_party_note: Revenue from major customers disclosed for IKIO Technologies Limited (₹1,460.08 Mn), Royalux Export Private Limited (₹440.46 Mn), Royalux Lighting Private Limited (₹1,092.85 Mn), and IKIO Solutions Private Limited (₹934.85 Mn) - indicating related party transactions within group entities
